import os,json
base='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0d1-u1-ceiling/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u086/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
import re
G=load()
pairs=[]
for i in (1,2,3):
    li,lo=f'Demo pair {i} input',f'Demo pair {i} output'
    pairs.append({'input':G[li],'output':G[lo]})
json.dump(pairs,open(base+'/task-3ba1f3e1.json','w'))
prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0]) // 2  # left block, col of 5s, right block
    left = [row[:w] for row in grid]
    right = [row[w+1:] for row in grid]
    # overlay right onto left only when the two shapes exactly tile the canvas
    zeros = sum(v == 0 for row in left for v in row)
    rcells = sum(v != 0 for row in right for v in row)
    overlap = any(l != 0 and r != 0 for lr, rr in zip(left, right) for l, r in zip(lr, rr))
    if zeros == rcells and not overlap:
        return [[r if l == 0 else l for l, r in zip(lr, rr)] for lr, rr in zip(left, right)]
    return [row[:] for row in left]
'''
open(base+'/task-3ba1f3e1.py','w').write(prog)
ns={}
exec(prog,ns)
for p in pairs:
    assert ns['transform'](p['input'])==p['output'], p
print('all demos ok')
out=ns['transform'](G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(out))
